package.name: aav_detector_rs
package.description: The object detector in Rust (rclrs): a drop-in for aav_detector's Python node (detector.launch.py detector_impl:=rust), a challenger, not the default. RF-DETR's ONNX through ONNX Runtime (the ort crate): Core ML on a Mac, the CPU anywhere, TensorRT on the Orin (untested). The same topics: image in; /perception/detections and /perception/detections/image out. The model and its maths are the detector-core crate, with no ROS.
